Prototype 6 encodes N2 (100% pure) primarily through EEG (82%), with EOG (11%) and EMG (7%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows elevated γ (+0.5 dB, sensitivity=4.3) and elevated β_h (+1.3 dB, sensitivity=3.1).
The γ activity is present in 3% of each epoch (transient), with quiescent eye movements (SEM 31% active) and atonic muscle tone.
This is coherent with N2 physiology: σ elevated, σ relevant, EOG quiescent — all confirmed. Note: model primarily uses γ, atypical for N2.
